title: Bolivia | World Coffee Guide
description: Almost all Bolivian coffee sits in the Yungas of La Paz, especially Caranavi. It is high-grown, often organic, and there is not much of it. Caturra and Catuai, usually washed.
seoDescription: Bolivia coffee guide: Caranavi and the Yungas, high-grown Caturra, and why the origin stays small.
